Contract Generator.contract:
Contract ManageCashierCRUDService::createCashier(id: Integer,name: String): Boolean {
	definition:
		cashier: Cashier = Cashier.allInstance()->any(o|o.Id = id)
	precondition:
		id.oclIsTypeOf(Integer) and
		name.oclIsTypeOf(String)
	postcondition:
		let newCashier: Cashier in
		newCashier.oclIsNew() and
		cashier.oclIsUndefined() = true and
		Cashier.allInstance()->includes(newCashier) and
		newCashier.Id = id and
		newCashier.Name = name and
		result = true or
		cashier.oclIsUndefined() = false and
		Cashier.allInstance()->includes(cashier) and
		cashier.Id = id and
		cashier.Name = name and
		result = true
}
